claim: South East Queensland (SEQ) is a bio-geographical, political, and administrative region of the state of Queensland in Australia first established in 1788. The area covered by South East Queensland varies, depending on the definition of the region, though it tends to include Queensland's three largest cities, including the Gold Coast, a coastal area in the Australian state of Queensland, approximately 66 km south-southeast of the state capital Brisbane and immediately north of the border with New South Wales.
